posts.title: What I do for good sleep
posts.description: A list of things that help me get quality rest. Software F.lux Reduces the blue light* output of your monitor in the evening, synchronized with sunset. This can enhance the normal feeling of drowsiness. This software is only available on computers. Android and iOS phones offer similar system settings that must be configured / turned on to work.
